goalbuddy_receipt_v1.summary: Implemented strict idempotent accepted/reverted decisions, producer convergence, replay-safe cached staging, authoritative subscriber handoff, pending file/reload protection, replacement-boundary reference validation, active-backlog pruning, and bounded terminal idempotency. Real HTTP and Vite tests cover terminal conflicts, pre-ack recovery, exactly-once effects, and unchanged revert history/revision. Chromium passed both viewports, keyboard review, injected pre-ack failure, undo/redo, manual/targeted edits, save/reopen, reload revert, producer statuses, and clean console. Durable 1,406-byte SVG matches reopened bytes and SHA-256; 120 tests, build, audit, and diff checks pass without CORS allowance.
